goals.statement: T0 Control Plane And Evidence Reconciliation: reconcile stale slice/task state before dispatching product work. Scope is harness/control-plane artifacts only: TMP-071 collision, stale .harness ready lists, v1 WorkOrders, schema validate-all failures, reconcile --check failures, and a manifest/backlog mapping table. Acceptance proof: agent-hub schema validate-all --root . --json passes; agent-hub reconcile --root . --check --json passes or reports only explicitly accepted external blockers; dispatch ready can run; evidence ledger records the reconciliation artifact; product code paths under services/**, frontend/webspa-admin/src/**, and common/** are forbidden.
success_criteria: A valid GoalSpec exists before HVC classification.
Generated WorkOrders validate against WorkOrder v2 schema.
Dispatch plan proves dependencies and write locks are safe.

non_goals: Do not perform unrelated repository-wide rewrites.
